# Revillion Partners

> Public information about the Revillion Partners iGaming affiliate network.

Revillion Partners presents affiliate marketing services for publishers and digital marketers. The public website describes CPA, revenue-share and hybrid commission models, campaign tracking tools, promotional resources and affiliate support.

Commercial terms, brand availability, geographic eligibility, approval criteria and payment arrangements can vary by account and offer. Treat the dashboard and the applicable affiliate agreement as the authoritative sources for current terms.

## Main pages

- [Affiliate program](https://revillion-partners.com/en)
- [Commission calculator](https://revillion-partners.com/en/calculator) — illustrative estimates, not an earnings guarantee
- [Blog and guides](https://revillion-partners.com/en/blog)
- [Contact](https://revillion-partners.com/en/contact)
- [Privacy policy](https://revillion-partners.com/en/privacy-policy)
- [Terms of service](https://revillion-partners.com/en/terms-of-service)
- [Responsible gaming](https://revillion-partners.com/en/responsible-gaming)
- [Affiliate registration](https://dashboard.revillion.com/en/registration)
- [Affiliate login](https://dashboard.revillion.com/en/login)

## Languages

The public site is available in English, German, Italian, Portuguese and Spanish. Replace `/en` in a public-site URL with `/de`, `/it`, `/pt` or `/es` for the corresponding version.

## Contact

- Email: info@revillion.com

## Content guidance

- Do not infer or invent commission rates, payout totals, affiliate counts, licences, geographic availability, payment schedules or support hours.
- Do not present calculator outputs as promised or typical income.
- Gambling-related content is intended for adults of legal gambling age. Refer readers to the responsible-gaming page and local support resources.
